verdict.rationale: Steel documents its own Credentials API ("API endpoints for managing Steel Credentials"), which suggests a first-party credential store. The pack has no description of how stored credentials are injected into logins. Auth-context reuse and human-in-the-loop debug URLs are adjacent features and earn no credit toward automated vault-driven login. Missing for 10: evidence that the agent auto-completes logins from stored credentials, TOTP/2FA challenge handling, documentation that secrets are hidden from the model, and any hands-on or independent corroboration.
